notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE // SPELLCASTERS: BREAKING THE LAW
notes.notes:
Dear Spellcasters, 

We are thrilled to announce part of the changes we have implemented in SpellPunk VR coming with today's major update. We really hope that you will like all of them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37019606/955d168c1ad2d405d43d17cd1b62423501a92353.png

What is new?

(1) A brand new aesthetics of the game  - Yes, it is still a comic book one, but once you have a look at the updated game, you can not disagree that now our avatars and battle arenas look totally dope, right?

and talking about the aesthetics…

(2)  Battle Arenas  - 12 battle scenes are awaiting you to play a magical multiplayer duel. We have not only completely revamped them, but we have also heard your voices and added some additional magic to each battle arena.

(3)  Locomotion  - You can now freely move on the battle platforms. But do have in mind that you can’t cast spells while you are moving. So… choose wisely. ;) 

(4)  Battle Platforms   - 3 x the size of the previous ones. And for extra coolness, the right and left parts are destructible. Yes, you definitely can destroy those parts of the platform when your opponent is on them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37019606/c7f805f6caba60981bd0a32604f9d7019b73fd28.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37019606/6079bf21ad25de896b2cf44ed5f3a9c8a5d5922c.png

(5)  Covers  - up to three destructible covers are there for you in order to protect you from the opponents powers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37019606/b597303f74c701a5d5c8e7f274452472ea7ae9c6.png

(6)  Game Rounds  - to win a magical duel versus an opponent now you have to win 2 out of 3 matches.

(7)  Spell recognition system  - we put a lot of work into fine tuning it. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37019606/393fd1328f31117b6e52490227ded1751f57fc5b.png

(8) Other small, and actually not so small, changes and (9) Bug fixes.

(10) ... added some bugs to fix them later :D 


Discounted Price till July 8, 2021 @ 10:05 am Pacific
You can now support us by buying SpellPunk VR at a special discounted price of 75% which will be valid till July 8, 2021 @ 10:05 am Pacific.

We will be extremely happy and grateful to have you as a part of our inspiring community!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1258980/SpellPunk_VR/

Thanks again for all of your support and we hope you enjoy all of the new features in the game!

What is coming next?
In the coming months we have plans to make SpellPunk even more stalwart with the implementation of new spells with the option to cast them with a single magical gesture or with a combination of gestures. The bigger the combination, the more powerful the spell will be. New combat scenes, characters, a short story about SpellPunk’s universe and the introduction of 2v2 and 3v3 multiplayer battles will also be added. Although those features are strictly planned out in our development cycle, we are willing to also implement features which came from you guys, our amazing community. Don't hesitate to share your suggestions speaking directly with our team in SpellPunk’s Discord Channel.

notes.title: REGULAR UPDATE: Private Rooms
notes.notes:
Dear Spellcasters, 

We are working on a HUGE update of our action multiplayer game SpellPunk VR, but while all of the new functionalities are cooking, we decided to introduce to you a brand new mode to our matchmaking system: Private Rooms. notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE: MAD MAGE WARRIOR
notes.notes:
Dear Spellcasters, 

We are thrilled to announce part of the changes we have implemented in SpellPunk VR coming with today's update. We hope that you will like them - some of them were in our development plan, others are inspired and designed from your ideas. 

What is new?
(1) a brand new Beginning of the game - yes, it is still a work in progress, but now you will get some initial context what SpellPunk is as an experience. You will be immersed in an atmosphere similar to the battle scenes, be able to learn 3 offensive and 1 defensive spells from the very beginning and maybe you will understand who you are as a character and what is your place in the SpellPunk's world.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37019606/62d6c1d1fd31ad187354b2c1098ae2ee6c3be4aa.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37019606/e164c8f92834e7d4da56b8d8860648d8024fa3fb.png

(2) an Invite Friends option - you can play SpellPunk versus a friend of yours and trust us when we are saying that adding this feature makes our game feel like a whole different experience filled with laughter, funny moments and a desire for revenge. The bonus is that playing with a friend you are not dependent on the multiplayer matchmaking system. 

(3) a brand new Training Mode - with a new and improved Training Mode, you’ll become an eruption of ether-fueled badassery against your opponents. We have completely changed the Training and here we are not only talking about its final look and atmosphere, but also we have changed its gameplay. You will still be able to learn different Spells in it but now you have to master some of them before you successfully unlock others. 

(4) a brand new Versus Bot experience - three new AI players enter the field, each with different strengths to give the single-player experience a whole new, challenging feel to prepare you for the multiplayer mode.

notes.title: UPDATE 3: We have heard the voices of our battlecaster community
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

We are thrilled to announce part of the updates we have made in the first two weeks after SpellPunk’s release:

(1) a brand new Spell Recognition System - yes, we put some insane amount of work, but your initial feedback was that in order to cast the spells you have to be very precise, so we decided to completely revamp the way our recognition system works and make it easier for you to cast the spells. We hope that now you finally will feel what it is like to be a real magician, but do not forget that you need to put some effort in learning at least how the symbols look like. And if you do that - we promise you, that you will play the game at the exact way as it is shown in the video below:

[previewyoutube=8jsvFt6md48;full][/previewyoutube]
(2) changed Magic Symbols - we have changed the magic symbols for the “Air” and “Water” spells. We are pretty sure that you will enjoy casting the Air symbol.

(3) Training Mode - we have changed the whole look of the Training Mode, painting it in different colours and also have added a small feature which will help you to learn how to cast the magical symbols better. You can take a look here:

[previewyoutube=WMeki288KP8;full][/previewyoutube]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37019606/1ef63d5519c863fcee03b2a39360454fccfd1561.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37019606/7ff39130b98b4844ee786bf41b5a7729db62d811.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37019606/b915e8989e1dc582896899e8bd3e7742e1e84272.png

(4) Main Menu Scene - entering SpellPunk’s main menu scene you will be able to immerse yourself in a brand new vibrant environment.

(5) Main Menu - we have completely changed how the main menu looks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37019606/eb2032512d6db14d3e8adbc456a63ed18cb7d0c1.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37019606/f0b11b3a3f6102999c8136b735273bab1250c17e.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37019606/27f988b25a5a0a61d8179a8b8d135ebb150e5346.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37019606/886735d101feba4a1d9181c1616b857c3c7b1223.png

(6) Game Settings - with this update you will be able to change music and sound volume and to change your graphics settings. More coming soon.

(7) Finding Match screen - you will be able to enjoy a cool comic book style art with your character while waiting for a multiplayer match to start

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37019606/b67ce98e30ab221204c28e1c8fef4d4fb97a09ea.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37019606/9f5584dd50f986e2f931d568c4602253d3876c1f.png

(8) Winner - Loser Screen - yes, you will see how your character looks when he or she is happy or sad.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37019606/000602a091c2496edac118e4f70bac0142d81f3e.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37019606/9db456aa8d48110aa1e5f11c5299af7ce7c7acf0.png

We have also fixed some (9) small bugs.

(10) We are finally supporting HTC Vive Cosmos controllers.

In the next big update we are planning to add more varied spells that will add to the action, leaderboards and an invite friends system so that you do not have to rely on the matchmaking system and challenge someone you will enjoy to duel with. Stay tuned. A lot more to come!

And last but not least - we are happy to invite you to SpellPunk’s brand new Discord Channel: https://discord.gg/ueR8GFr

Best wishes and thank you for being part of our community,
Incineration Production’s Team

notes.title: UPDATE 2: Further Improvements of the Spell Recognition System
notes.notes:
Hey guys, today (30th of April) we have uploaded a new build of SpellPunk in which we have completely revamped the spell recognition system. We have also changed the symbols for the Water and Air Spells.
Give it a try and let us know what do you think.

notes.title: UPDATE 1: Improvements To The Spell Recognition System
notes.notes:
Hey guys, 

First of all, a HUGE Thank you to all of you who have bought and wishlisted our game. We are extremely happy to have you in our community. Now you are part of our journey. You rock! 

Second, we wanted to let you know that we are grateful for the feedback you are sharing with us via our support email, reviews and social media channels. Also sending us videos with the bugs you are experiencing is extremely helpful. 

Yesterday (26th of April) we have uploaded a new version of the game in which we have fine tuned the spell recognition system. We saw in some of the videos you have sent to us that some of you are not able to cast the spells properly. That is why we decided to improve the tutorial as well.

You can try the new spell casting recognition system directly in the game or have a fast sneak peak of the tutorial here:
